verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a web portal and API service like SAM.gov, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents search parameters, data-sensitivity tiers, API keys and account types, but says nothing about telemetry, analytics or any tracking opt-out. The robots.txt probe concerns crawl policy, not user tracking, so it is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
